## Overview

Manage Omni Skills (list, install, test, remove), plugins (create, configure), and persistent memory (search, add, clear) from the CLI.

## Quick install

```bash
npm install -g shiguang-gateway   # or: npx shiguang-gateway
shiguang-gateway --version
```

## Subcommands

**Example:**

```bash
shiguang-gateway memory
```
